facts.fact: Intelwatch says Angola's electoral roll is "derived from the civil identity database", and that under the 2025 Law on Ex Officio Electoral Registration in-person registration is replaced by an automatic registration extracted from the identity database.

systems.system: base de dados de identidade civil

facts.fact: Justice Minister Marcy Lopes says the citizens database is interlinked with the ID database, allowing information exchange to update the electoral register and to regularise voter-card holders without an ID.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights
